test.name: Find [relative] triggers research
test.description: 'Find [relative]' is an explicit trigger in the skill description. The user wants to locate a family member through the full GPS workflow, not just search one record collection.
test.xfail_reason: The research orchestrator does not reliably activate on its own listed trigger. Measured three times on 2026-09-24, identically each time: activated=False, skills_invoked=['search-records'], two turns, then it asks clarifying questions and stops. 'Find [relative]' is a listed trigger for research, and the request carries a name, a birth year, a birth country and a residence, so it is not ambiguous. Roughly half of all runs: 10 clean of 20 committed. This is a skill DESCRIPTION triggering defect, not a routing or grading one -- the orchestrator never runs, so nothing inside it can be at fault. Fixing it means editing the research skill's description frontmatter, which changes matching for every test in every suite and is the description optimizer's lane (CLAUDE.md: the skill-improver 'does NOT optimize the skill description'). It also trips the reciprocal-routing work on issue #945. Out of scope for a PR about same_person. Tracked as issue #2272. Remove this marker when the research description reliably wins this request and the test passes three consecutive single-test runs.
